item.description:
Toucan 1.0.13

  • You can now drag the Entity Map from anywhere on it, including over boxes, lines and the family box. A click on a box still opens it.
  • A family member with no family link sits at the end of the family box’s top row, and lines leaving the family box no longer run under another person’s card.

Toucan 1.0.12

Please update every Mac before anyone adds a name in the new Place category. An older copy of Toucan shows it as a category it doesn’t know.

  • Fewer categories, simpler to choose from: Fund is now part of Entity, Property and Location are now Place, and Reference is now Account. Names already in those categories move across and keep their tokens, so files tokenised before still restore.
  • Family now means one member of the family. Everyone else, from staff to a supplier’s contact, is a Person.
  • A new name starts as Other unless Toucan can tell what it is, such as Ltd for a company or a street address for a place.
  • A client’s Structure page lists names in six groups: Family, People, Organisations, Places and assets, Numbers and contact details, and Other.
  • When you link a person to a family member as their child, parent, spouse or sibling, Toucan asks whether they’re a family member too, in the editor and under the Entity Map’s Issues. Make Family Member changes their category, and Not Now stops Toucan asking about them.
  • The Entity Map’s family box holds family members only, the map sits in the middle of its area, and a faint grid of dots behind it helps line up the boxes.

Toucan 1.0.11

  • On a client’s Structure page, clicking a name now opens its editor straight away even when you’ve scrolled down past the top of the list. Before, it could fail to open until you scrolled back up.
